Rust terminal WebSocket acks emit numeric code 500, but the TS ErrorCode table has no corresponding declaration.
Rust debug envelopes emit 40000 for rejected debug operations, but the TS ErrorCode table has no corresponding declaration.
Rust bearer authentication emits 40101; TS mentions it only in the reserved-code comment, not in the ErrorCode table.
Rust debug envelopes emit 40400 for missing debug resources and methods, but the TS ErrorCode table has no corresponding declaration.
Rust debug envelopes emit 50000 for debug-store failures, but the TS ErrorCode table has no corresponding declaration.
